scope: First bounded P00/P01 implementation slice. No event-driven scheduler migration is claimed.
changes: Nine uncached ledger reads replace full inspections for living-duty, commander, qualification, HQ eligibility, held equipment, sight candidates and nearby patients.
Military/HQ automation preserves its ordering and physical delivery, but filters ineligible recipients before exporting full records.
Orders use detached person/carrier sight metadata, retaining their existing visibility, affiliation, assignment and reporting rules.
Medic candidate selection exports only living friendly wounded people inside the existing 60 metre radius, preserving insertion order.
Four optional monotonic wall-time scopes record calls, total and maximum duration with the existing per-second reports.
GdUnit4 adds six focused guards: duration windows, frozen behavior, predicates, repeated-check inspection costs, actual contact parity and patient selection.
Source-map extraction now handles multiline callbacks with absent parser endpoints; an added regression test prevents whole-file callback ranges.

behavior_baseline.capture: Captured twice before production read changes; all 13 checkpoint hashes matched. Opt-in capture refuses to overwrite an existing destination.
behavior_baseline.coverage: Canonical ledger, military formations/reports/commander, HQ jobs/status and receiving state at opening, two seconds, leader loss/wait/replacement, HQ receipt and timed real issue boundaries; coarse/partitioned HQ completion.
behavior_baseline.result: All 13 original expected hashes match the final implementation; every checkpoint audit is clean. Actual hull has three E25 shells and five M08 fuel; rifle holder is read-trained.
behavior_baseline.strict_json_note: Only explanatory non-finite tank/rifle detail values were normalized to strings after capture. Expected canonical hashes and original source hashes were not regenerated.
behavior_baseline.limits: Focused explicit-time fixtures, not proof of every gameplay state, live wall-clock planning path, Pause/2x behavior or all planned overhaul contracts.

measurement_limits: Each measurement is one batch of 100 calls with counters enabled and stacks disabled. Inspection counts are structural evidence; elapsed wall times include diagnostic/OS effects and are not statistical CPU benchmarks or a whole-game speedup.

formal_run.mode: Headless, counters-only; stack guard deliberately captures its own fixture calls
formal_run.isolated_import_note: import-errors.log contains editor-settings write errors in the restricted environment; no claim of clean import stderr or manual GUI testing.

unresolved_live_failure.interpretation: Largest measured live tick was 56.682 ms; these inclusive scope maxima do not explain or uniquely attribute the 118.642 ms frame interval. Multiple ticks, untimed work and scheduling/pacing remain possible. Do not sum parent/child totals or equate a frame gap to exclusive CPU time.
unresolved_live_failure.consequence: Suite stopped and paused; later menus/actions remain untested. The 100 ms budgets were not relaxed.

other_runs.result: Before slice: bounded one-step Build observation completed. Not a full sweep.
First read slice: seven guards passed; live failed at 121.943 ms during Build rotation.
Intermediate added-test run exposed typed-array and fixture-ID errors. Both fixture defects were corrected before final verification.
Nine guards passed; live failed at 116.465 ms during Build placement before wall scopes were added.

preserved_contracts: Single authoritative ledger and shared clock
No persistent read caches requiring invalidation
Existing mutation, settlement and observation order
Synchronous mine contact and wreck consequences
Current empty-field opening and disabled editor addons
Physical HQ arrival/issue and leader replacement timing in the characterized fixtures
remaining_work: Attribute the reproducible Build-phase frame-budget failure with finer frame/CPU measurements before changing timing behavior.
Replace broad military/HQ polling only after committed-change wakeups and mutation coverage exist.
Audit the wider mutation matrix and prerequisite-rich scenarios before adding indexes or migrating other services.
Run the full reachable menu sweep past the remaining failure; unreached actions remain untested.

map_tool_verification.limits: Tool correctness tests do not certify gameplay.

raw_log_availability: Raw logs are local ignored artifacts. This tracked evidence preserves the salient results; fresh checkouts must rerun tests to produce raw logs.
